summary.intro: Every missed call gets a text back within a minute with your booking link, booked jobs land on the dispatch calendar, and you get a weekly count of what was missed and what was saved.
bottom_line: A missed call stops being a lost job. The caller gets a text and a way to book right away.
Nothing new. Booked jobs show up on the calendar they already use.

sections.title: How it works
paras: A missed call triggers a text with your booking link. Booked jobs go straight onto the dispatch calendar with the caller's notes.

support: Thirty days of support after delivery. If anything doesn't behave the way this proposal says, I fix it at no charge.
